new_claim: For Boolean uniform product null and fixed retention rho, bounded degree-D LDA rules out strong distinction by polynomial-size constant-read unions of arbitrary local Boolean witnesses whose null mass is at most exp(-alpha times width) for fixed alpha > log(1+rho^2), provided D/log m -> infinity and the null union probability tends to zero. The fixed finite-alphabet threshold is alpha > log(1+(s-1)rho^2).
source_scope: PROVED PARTIAL only; not a source-general characterization and not a proof of an unrestricted low-degree conjecture.
mao_boundary: Mao's rank test cannot admit a subexponential-in-D constant-read union representation by such sufficiently rare arbitrary local witnesses; more generally k_n[-log(1-q_n)] >= 1-o(1) for any such representation with log m_n=o(D_n).
next_attack: Replace the exponential-rarity assumption by a local spectral-entropy or one-sided-majorant condition, then robustify Haramaty-Lee-Viola from exact bounded independence to bounded LDA for non-rare bounded block tests.
